Specification: This module is a minimal TLA+ specification used to reference or exercise standard library modules and temporal syntax rather than to model a realistic distributed algorithm. It declares a single variable x, initializes it with the predicate FALSE /\ x = 0, and defines Next as the temporal formula [][FALSE /\ x' = x]_<<x>>. The module is syntactically valid but degenerate as a system model because Init is unsatisfiable.
